messages:
Incident Bot: PagerDuty alert fired: high-severity host failure on host gpu-3a2 (us-west-2a).
PagerDuty: Incident automatically created: PD-87312 — Kernel panic / kubelet not ready on gpu-3a2
Maya Patel: acked. I'm oncall. Pulling logs.
Ashwin Rao: adding context — this host is in the dedicated-gpu pool serving redwood-dedicated-1.
Maya Patel: kubectl shows node NotReady and kubelet CrashLoop. Running `kubectl get nodes gpu-3a2 -o wide` now.
Maya Patel: output: `gpu-3a2   NotReady   1h    10.0.4.23   ip-10-0-4-23.ec2.internal`
Maya Patel: checking `journalctl -u kubelet -b` — lots of kernel oops messages.
Maya Patel: paste logs:
`````
[   14.532141] BUG: unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference at 0000000000000000
[   14.532152] RIP: 0010:gpu_driver_fault_handler+0x2d/0x80
[   14.532160] Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal GPU driver exception
`````
Maya Patel: ^ looks like GPU driver triggered panic at boot.
Ryan Chen: any customer-facing errors? Priya, can CS confirm.
Priya Singh (CS): getting notes — two customers reported 504s in us-west around 13:02 UTC. Investigating impact (a small subset of heavy gen jobs failed).
Jordan SRE: recommended immediate mitigation: cordon + drain to migrate pods off host; also disable routing to node at LB level.
Maya Patel: cordoning now: `kubectl cordon gpu-3a2` -> success.
Maya Patel: draining: `kubectl drain gpu-3a2 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force` -> several pods evicted, a couple stuck terminating (long-running GPU jobs). Forcing deletion on stuck pods.
Ashwin Rao: starting migration script to spin fallback on dedicated-gpu-fallback pool and re-create heavy pods with nodeSelector tolerations.
Ashwin Rao: command run:
`````
./infra/migrate_gpu_pods.sh --from gpu-3a2 --to dedicated-gpu-fallback
`````
Maya Patel: hardware oncall +1 — need console serial / IPMI check. @Hardware Oncall can you remote into host and check NVMe / PCIe resets?
Hardware Oncall: attaching to serial console now. Seeing repeated GPU PCIe resets and ECC errors. Suspect card failure. I'll powercycle PCIe and report.
Hardware Oncall: powercycle performed. Host reboots but kernel oops repeats during init, same GPU driver backtrace. Host remains Kube NotReady.
Ryan Chen: scaling fallback pool now — `terraform apply` ramping dedicated-gpu-fallback +4 nodes to absorb traffic, and increasing autoscaler target for 10m.
Maya Patel: updated status page draft — short outage notice for subset of customers in us-west. Priya please post when ready.
Priya Singh (CS): posting status now. Customers notified: intermittent failures for GPU inference jobs in us-west, mitigation in progress, engineers investigating hardware.
Jordan SRE: classifying this as hardware failure. Opening RMA ticket for gpu-3a2 and scheduling maintenance window to replace GPU card. Also will trigger a postmortem if total tenant impact >1% RPS.
Maya Patel: documenting timeline in incident doc; will add kernel logs, evacuation commands, and RMA ticket link.
Jordan SRE: taking follow-up handoff. I'll coordinate with hardware and infra for RMA and revalidation. If anything changes ping me directly.
Maya Patel: thanks — handing off to Jordan SRE in 15m. I'll remain available for context. :white_check_mark:
Incident Bot: PagerDuty incident PD-87312 status updated: acknowledged -> escalated -> assigned to Jordan SRE
